body.title: chore(deps): migrate go-yaml usage to v4
body.body:
Replay of `https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/32854` for triage testing.

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Migrate Helm's direct go-yaml v3 usage to go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 v4.0.0.
This covers plugin metadata and configuration, hook namespace parsing,
and the encoder used by toYamlPretty.

Keep the classic APIs and existing indentation settings.
Add regression tests confirming unchanged output for nested collections,
quoted strings, and multiline text.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

V3 remains an indirect dependency through upstream dependencies.
Other sigs.k8s.io/yaml calls retain their existing JSON conversion behavior.
No public Go signatures or CLI interfaces change.

**Validation**:

- All 60 unit packages passed, with path tests run separately without
  Helm home-directory overrides.
- Both additional chart lint tests with linker flags passed.
- CLI build and version smoke test passed.
- golangci-lint v2.14.0 reported zero issues.
- Module tidy, diff, and tracked-source license checks passed.

**If applicable**:

- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes
- [x] this PR contains unit tests
- [x] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility

commit.message:
chore(deps): migrate go-yaml usage to v4

Switch Helm's direct go-yaml imports to v4.0.0, including the encoder
used by toYamlPretty.
Keep the classic APIs and indentation settings to preserve existing
validation and output behavior.

Add regression cases for nested collections, quoted strings, and
multiline text.
Retain v3 as an indirect dependency for upstream consumers.

Signed-off-by: Ingy döt Net <ingy@ingy.net>

fix(engine): preserve pretty YAML formatting

Use the v4 dumper with v3 defaults, two-space indentation, and unlimited
line width so toYamlPretty retains the v3 output format.
Handle dumper construction, output, and close errors consistently.

Add regression cases for long strings and ambiguous YAML scalars.
Verify the long-line case fails before the fix and passes afterward.

Signed-off-by: Ingy döt Net <ingy@ingy.net>
